{{Quote|Alert! Incoming attack. Protocol 514 initiated.|An automated alarm at Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879|<ref name="Imminent Impact">{{WizCite|story=Imminent Impact|book=The Unknown Regions}}</ref>}}
'''Protocol 514''' was a code that, when activated, caused the minds of all the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were based in the [[Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] to be [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]]. At some point, [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]] hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some semi-processed [[TOL-type ore]] in contravention to a [[Profit-Sharing Agreement Relaali 374.5.2|profit-sharing agreement]]. After the violation was detected by the other parties to the contract, Tor-Ro-Bo activated the protocol, to conceal the spacers' presence in Processing Center 879.<ref name="Imminent Impact" />
